source.title: Source collection and path
source.description: Where the data currently lives. Directory paths should end with a slash.

destination.title: Destination collection and path
destination.description: Where the data should be copied to.

search_index.title: Search index
search_index.description: UUID of the Globus Search index to ingest into.

subject.title: Search subject
subject.description: Unique subject identifier for the Search entry (for example a dataset ID or URL).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: The metadata document to store as the Search entry content.

visible_to.title: Visible to
visible_to.description: Principal URNs allowed to see the entry, or 'public'.
